content: Anuwa marak kari John den apuram
Imi Jesus Kristus, Kaem ko Namar, ko den gilalong. Duakining te
prophet Isaiah ko batoga te iwita ko balam:

content.text: “Ani kari bo bitirik se girok aninga den
giok ago namaruk ale nika lage nungok burangaruk ale dingumurokko.”
“Ali sor garagarayam mu te kari bo ai baluwoso,
‘Kari Biya ko lage te tairukko mu
nungal burangaral ale lage tuang dingumuralko,’ ma baluwoso.”

content: Se John tairam, nu koma garagarayam mu te baga se kariimet anuwa marak nungaru se den balukaso, “Giris palagal ale anuwa marak tal se Kaem ninga ikup memek mu siwurokko,” makaso.
Se Judea sor ko wonong saki wonong biya mu ko buring bagara mu se, Jerusalem ko kariimet kote namakasan. Ale nunga memek wetang te balu sapakasan se nu yu Jordan ningi anuwa marak nungarukaso.
John nu prophet, se guang camel mone te nungurman mu katakaso, ale let biling bo luan kalokaso. Nu locust se honey ko inang ko nokaso.

Ale nu iwita kariimet nunga manarukaso, “Kari bo ani agowom kaoram taiwoso mu nu nup biya se sokel garagar, se aninga kiaram. Ani noko doleng tuagu lakira ko mayang abugura kulukek ale kutuwurekko am me terongtala, mu awuk, ani nu koma te ningo nuam mena.
Ani yu te anuwa marak ningarsam. Bare nu mu Bur Laili ko sokel te baptais ningarukko.”
Jesus anuwa marak tam se Satan nu ira arigam
Se Jesus Nazareth wonong Galilee ningi baga tairam se John yu Jordan ningi anuwa marak tuam.
Se Jesus yu beteram ale aratu se duruk wonong kaigam se Bur Laili inangnang biton iwita kote kaparam mu arigam.
Se duruk wonong te kuring bo tai kaparam ale mam, “Ni aninga Namar, ani ninguru ka kuesam, ale ni ko ko ninguru amilmilasam.”
Se Bur Laili tom umu te la Jesus ilak sor garagarayam mu te namaram.
Nu day tom 40 ko umu te bagakaso se Satan nu ira ariga te bitakaso. Jesus mel daong nunga ningi bagakaso, se engel alo ilak pingi bagakasan.
Me kam la Galilee ura duap beteram
Tom John talipara ningi beteman, mu Jesus Galilee namaram, ale Kaem ko den gilalong balu pagarukaso.
Nu makaso, “Aitak tom aram. Kaem ko kingdom tai pingi aram. Se giris palagal ale den gilalong ko nengemang ningi nunguning arukko!”
Jesus ko olekem nunga gia duap beteram
Jesus Yu Galilee norogen kaoram ale aolak iluwa, nu Simon ko uria Andrew ilak pote sapawaman se nungarkam. Nuna ilagala wal tata kari.
Se nu nunga maonam, “Nina tairal ani agowom kaoral, se ani kariimet nunga gia ko munan ninga kausekko,” mam.
Se nuna pasak ala nunga pote mel awu beteman ale kowom karoman.
Nu aolak ilu awar me namaram mu Zebedee ko namar James ko uria John ilak dal te pote nunguru burangiwaman se nungarkam.
Nu numi me iram, am nunga auram, se nuna nunga nonet Zebedee ko ura kari ago dal ningi nunga awu beteman, ale kowom karoman.
Jesus bur memek bo kaoram
Nuna Capernaum namaman, se Sabbath tom se Jesus synagogue ningi namaram ale kariimet den nunga kasurukaso.
Se kariimet noko kausa den mu ko ninguru nongomang pitigiram, mu awuk, nuna arigiman mu nu law ko kausa kari iwita me bitakaso, bare noko ura mu duap bo se sokel ago bitakaso.
Tom me maiyam mu, kari bo synagogue ningi nongorak bagaram mu nu bur memek ago mu airam,
“Jesus, Nazareth kari, ni ana awuk nanga bitarko? Ni anananga maguwurko tairem e? Ani ni awiriya mu ka ikisam, ni Kaem ko Kakirip Laili!”
Bare Jesus alis tuam, “Ni kutek me ale kari sowore bitarko!” mam.
Se bur memek mu kari mu ninguru sisuwuram maguwuram, ale sail ago airam ale kari mu beteram.
Se kariimet suen la ninguru uririkiman ale nunumi isarukasan, “Ewere anape ya? Bala se kausa iru se sokel ago! Nu bur memek ago la balso se kuring karosan,” makasan.
Se noko dugu duap mu tairate Galilee koma mu lilim la ningi geraga saparam.
Jesus kuera ikes ago mu nunga nungurukaso
Se tom synagogue beteman arataman mu James se John arungak Simon se Andrew nunga kawam te namaman.
Simon ko nome nu kuera kowar ago aniwaram ko den mu Jesus manorman se ikiam.
Se nu kote namaram, kuting te iluwam ale saongam se barasam, se noko kuera mu menaram. Se nu nunga inang mel nunguru burangikaso.
Bainga ningi, worem kapa naguram se kariimet kuera ikes ago se bur memek ago mu nongorak Jesus kote taikasan.
Wonong mu ko kariimet lilim la taiman se kawam kuring mu sisiram.

Se Jesus kariimet kuera ikes duap duap ago mu nunga nungurukaso, ale bur memek ago mu bur memek nunga karokaso. Bare nu bur memek mu nuguring kaolam se me munakakasan, mu awuk, nuna nu awiriya mu ko ikiman.
Jesus Galilee sor te ura bita geragam
Tumong biyala sor ninguru me ukiram la Jesus barasam, kawam beteram ale kuwim bo kutekam wore te namaram ale kota baga se guranek bitakaso.
Se Simon ko kari ago ko loagakasan,
ale tom ari gilingiman mu manorman, “Kariimet suen biya nika loagawasan!” maman.
Se Jesus mam, “Tairal se namanak wonong pingi pingi wore te namanak se ani den apurek se nuna karogo la ikimonko. Mu awuk, ani borta ko tairem,” mam.
Se nu Galilee ningi wonong suen la te geraga se, nunga synagogue suen biya ningi den apu se bur memek nunga karokaso.
Jesus kari bo kumik laira posara ago wore nungam
Kari bo kuera laira posara ago mu Jesus kote tairam ale bugura kulukam ale ilak wosengakaso, “Ni ka gemang buta aniruk agi mu asele ni aninga nunguru se angimik nungerukko,” mam.
Se Jesus kari mu ko gomang motam batagam, se kuting garukam ale kari mu kumik kau tam ale mam, “Aninga angamang butata aniso. Nungerko!” mam.
Se tairanamar kuera mu beteram se nu nungeram.
Se Jesus kari mu den aora biya maonam ale beteram se namaram.

“Ni ikiko!” mam. “Ni kari bo kiwem kimik te aratam imi manaru se me ikiokko. Bare dirme ale priest kote namar ale, keta nimi kasuru ale Moses te balam uwutata, tama bita Kaem tui se, kariimet nika munan umu te la sinarmonko,” mam.

Bare mena, kari mu namaram amilmil te balu balu geragakaso mu te den pagam. Se duap umu te Jesus wetang te wonong bo ningi namarukko me terong. Nu wonong buring ko kuwim kariimet mena wore te la bagakaso. Bare mena, kariimet sor suen biya ko wore am kote taiwakasan.

footnotes.text: John ko guang se ko na inang: 2 Kings 1:8; Zechariah 13:4.
